title: GARDRec: Decision-Level Graph Grounding for Large Language Model Recommendation
title_zh: GARDRec：面向大语言模型推荐的决策级图 grounding
abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) offer new opportunities for recommendation by interpreting item descriptions, user instructions, and external knowledge through natural-language prompts. However, existing graph-augmented LLM recommenders often use knowledge graphs mainly as prompt-level evidence, leaving ranking decisions weakly constrained by structured user-item relations. This is problematic for next-item recommendation, where the model must compare candidates under the same user context while preserving temporal preference, collaborative signals, and attribute matches. To address this issue, we propose \emph{GARDRec}, a Graph-grounded Adaptive Reasoning and Decision-aware Recommendation framework for LLM-based next-item ranking. GARDRec constructs semantic-structural item representations from textual node features and graph propagation, derives personalized graph contexts from temporally weighted histories and first-order neighborhoods, and aligns graph-derived representations with a frozen LLM through continuous multimodal prompts. Explicit interaction and matching features are injected through late-stage decision branches, while inter-candidate attention and restricted generative likelihood support final ranking. Experiments on three public benchmarks with multiple LLM backbones show that GARDRec generally improves candidate-ranking performance over representative baselines. Ablation and diagnostic analyses verify the contributions of graph projection, neighborhood retrieval, explicit decision features, ranking loss, and generative calibration.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 GARDRec，一个用于 LLM-based next-item ranking 的 Graph-grounded Adaptive Reasoning and Decision-aware Recommendation 框架。针对现有 graph-augmented LLM recommender 主要将知识图作为 prompt 证据、难以在排序决策层充分约束结构化 user-item 关系的问题，GARDRec 将文本节点特征与图传播结合，构建语义-结构 item 表示；基于时间加权用户历史与一阶邻域检索生成个性化 graph context；并通过连续 multimodal prompts 将图表示对齐到冻结的 LLM。框架还在后期决策分支中注入显式交互与匹配特征，结合 inter-candidate attention 和受限生成似然进行最终排序。三组公开 benchmark 与多个 LLM backbone 上的实验表明，GARDRec 通常优于代表性 baseline；消融与诊断分析进一步验证了图投影、邻域检索、显式决策特征、排序损失和生成校准的有效性。
key_points_zh: 问题聚焦：现有图增强 LLM 推荐多停留在 prompt-level evidence，排序决策仍缺乏对 temporal preference、collaborative signals 和属性匹配的强约束。
核心方法：GARDRec 结合文本节点特征与 graph propagation，学习 semantic-structural item representations，并从时间加权历史与一阶邻域中构造 personalized graph contexts。
LLM 对齐：通过 continuous multimodal prompts 将图派生表示接入 frozen LLM，避免全量微调，同时保留语言模型的语义推理能力。
决策增强：在 late-stage decision branches 注入显式 interaction/matching features，并使用 inter-candidate attention 与 restricted generative likelihood 支持候选排序。
实验结论：在三个公开 benchmark 和多个 LLM backbone 上，GARDRec 相比代表性 baseline 整体提升 candidate-ranking performance；消融验证各模块均有贡献。

llm_assessment.comment: A technically solid LLM-graph recommendation framework with useful ranking improvements, but only weakly grounded in e-commerce-specific shopping workflows.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作在LLM与图推荐结合上较扎实并有排序改进，但与电商购物场景的绑定较弱。
